purpose: Reproduce the accepted manuscript's stated Python 3.9 and TensorFlow 2.9 execution stack separately from the released repository's Python 3.7/TensorFlow 2.4 stack.
provenance_notes: The manuscript states TensorFlow 2.9 but not a patch release; 2.9.3 is selected as the final 2.9 patch and is not claimed author-exact.
TensorFlow 2.9.3 requires protobuf below 3.20; protobuf 3.19.6 is an explicit solver-compatibility pin, replacing the initially declared incompatible 3.20.3.
TensorFlow Addons is needed only for compatibility checks against released optimizer/loss semantics; the corrected scaffold implements the verified N-pairs formula directly.

The paper reports an RTX 3060 and batch size 128. This machine has an RTX 3050 6GB; microbatching or gradient accumulation will be an explicitly labelled hardware adaptation if batch 128 does not fit.
